import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess

repo = Path('/root/.codex/worktrees/f396/medaka')
scratch = Path('/tmp/medaka-whole-init-85')
previous = Path('/tmp/medaka-retained-tree-profile-85c364304')
source = scratch / 'phase-source'
source.mkdir()
gc = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '85c364304684c44c544957c8ba2b180d15d736c5:test/gc_prototype/gc.c'], cwd=repo)
assert hashlib.sha256(gc).hexdigest() == '8b3d4bf65beccb9a019d2330f8266fc5261120140d94b611981add3b720876b4'
(source / 'gc.c').write_bytes(gc)
shutil.copyfile(scratch / 'candidate/gc.h', source / 'gc.h')
base = (scratch / 'baseline/workload.c').read_text()
candidate = (scratch / 'candidate/workload.c').read_text()
phase = (previous / 'test/gc_prototype/workload-phase.c').read_text()
tree_begin, tree_end = 'static Word tree(', 'static uint64_t sum_tree('
old_tree = base[base.index(tree_begin):base.index(tree_end)]
new_tree = candidate[candidate.index(tree_begin):candidate.index(tree_end)]
assert phase.count(old_tree) == 1
phase = phase.replace(old_tree, new_tree)
old_begin = base.rindex('      Word node = work_allocate(list_layout());')
new_begin = candidate.rindex('      Word node = work_allocate(list_layout());')
boundary = '      if ((ephemeral &&'
old_list = base[old_begin:base.index(boundary, old_begin)]
new_list = candidate[new_begin:candidate.index(boundary, new_begin)]
assert phase.count(old_list) == 1
phase = phase.replace(old_list, new_list)
(source / 'workload.c').write_text(phase)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc_run', repo / 'test/gc_prototype/run.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
mod.HERE, mod.REPO = source, repo
build = scratch / 'build'
build.mkdir()
mod.adapter(build)
arms = {
    'custom_current': (('USE_PREPARED', 'INLINE_ALLOC', 'INLINE_STORE'), False),
    'custom_whole': (('USE_PREPARED', 'INLINE_ALLOC', 'INLINE_STORE', 'WHOLE_INIT'), False),
    'boehm_caller_current': (('USE_BOEHM', 'USE_CALLER_INLINE', 'USE_PREPARED', 'INLINE_ALLOC', 'INLINE_STORE'), True),
    'boehm_caller_whole': (('USE_BOEHM', 'USE_CALLER_INLINE', 'USE_PREPARED', 'INLINE_ALLOC', 'INLINE_STORE', 'WHOLE_INIT'), True),
    'boehm_inline': (('USE_BOEHM', 'USE_INLINE'), True),
}
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GC_')}
env['GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR'] = '1'
manifest = {'baseline_commit': '85c364304684c44c544957c8ba2b180d15d736c5',
            'gc_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(gc).hexdigest(),
            'gc_h_sha256': hashlib.sha256((source / 'gc.h').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'workload_sha256': hashlib.sha256((source / 'workload.c').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'phase_source': str(source), 'boehm': mod.boehm_config(), 'arms': {},
            'clock_policy': 'Same prior phase workload with three per-process tree-boundary clock reads on all arms.',
            'compile_policy': 'clang -std=c11 -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror; separate TUs, no LTO, full assertions.',
            'adapter_paths': [str(build / 'boehm_adapter.c'), str(build / 'boehm_caller.h')],
            'environment': {'GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR': '1', 'other_GC_vars': 'cleared'}}
custom_reference = {}
boehm_reference = {}
for name, (defines, boehm) in arms.items():
    binary = mod.build(build, name, defines, boehm=boehm)
    result = subprocess.run([str(binary), '--selftest'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    assert result.stdout == 'selftest passed\n' and not result.stderr
    rows = []
    for capacity in (240, 262136, 262144):
        for profile in mod.PROFILES:
            result = subprocess.run([str(binary), profile, '4096', str(capacity)], check=True,
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
            assert not result.stderr
            row = json.loads(result.stdout)
            assert row['checksum'] == 4096 * 4095 // 2
            assert row['allocations'] == 4096 + (profile == 'mutation')
            key = (capacity, profile)
            counters = {k: v for k, v in row.items() if 'seconds' not in k and 'rss' not in k}
            if name == 'custom_current':
                custom_reference[key] = counters
            elif name == 'custom_whole':
                assert counters == custom_reference[key], (name, key, counters, custom_reference[key])
            else:
                # Boehm placement and conservative stack retention are not deterministic.
                common = {k: row[k] for k in ('profile', 'count', 'checksum', 'allocations', 'payload_bytes', 'layout_manifest_bytes', 'descriptor_bytes_after_prepare')}
                if name == 'boehm_caller_current':
                    boehm_reference[key] = common
                else:
                    assert common == boehm_reference[key]
            rows.append(row)
    assembly = build / (name + '.s')
    assembly.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['objdump', '-d', str(binary)]))
    manifest['arms'][name] = {'binary': str(binary), 'binary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                              'defines': defines, 'command': mod.BUILD_COMMANDS[name],
                              'selftest': 'passed', 'smoke_rows': rows, 'assembly': str(assembly)}
manifest['adapter_sha256'] = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                             for p in (build / 'boehm_adapter.c', build / 'boehm_caller.h')}
manifest['build_helper_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(scratch / 'build-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'arms': {k: {'selftest': v['selftest'], 'smoke_rows': len(v['smoke_rows']),
                              'binary_sha256': v['binary_sha256']} for k, v in manifest['arms'].items()},
                  'gc_h_sha256': manifest['gc_h_sha256'], 'workload_sha256': manifest['workload_sha256']}))
